:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Chap 3.9.6.1 (Table 82) of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/updateReasonType.xml).
:::

`updateReasonType` is the attribute that states what type of change a reason for update (`reasonForUpdate`) describes when a data module is revised. It is optional. `reasonForUpdate` is written inside `dmStatus`, `pmStatus`, `imfStatus`, `scormContentPackageStatus`, `targetDmStatus`, and `frontMatterDmEntry`, `frontMatterPmEntry` and `frontMatterExternalPubEntry` of `frontmatter.xsd`.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 1 element carries this attribute.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reasonForUpdate` | 25 | Optional |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided in two steps: by the XML schema and by BREX (Business Rules Exchange).

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `updateReasonTypeAttType` (based on `xs:string`). The values are an enumeration of 99 values, from `urt01` to `urt99` |
| Default BREX (BREX-S1-00242) | Allows 6 values (including ranges and patterns) for `//@updateReasonType`. The rule applies to all schemas |

Of the values in the XML schema enumeration, the 45 values `urt06` to `urt50` are not allowed by BREX-S1-00242. They pass XML schema validation, but they are violations in a check against the default BREX.

BREX-S1-00242 allows the following values and defines how a lower-level BREX can tailor each of them.

| Value | `valueForm` | `valueTailoring` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `urt01` to `urt05` | `single` | `lexical` |
| `urt51~urt99` | `range` | `restrictable` |

## Meaning of the values

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `urt01` | An editorial change. It contains no technical change. No change markup is linked to this reason |
| `urt02` | A technical change. Unless the `issueType` of the issue is `revised`, change markup linked to this reason is needed |
| `urt03` | A change to the markup only. If it affects the technical content and the `issueType` of the issue is `changed`, the change is marked |
| `urt04` | A change to the applicability markup only. If it does not affect the technical content, or the `issueType` is not `changed`, no change markup is added |
| `urt05` | A change to the reference markup only. Change markup is handled in the same way as for `urt04` |
| `urt51` to `urt99` | Values whose meaning the project defines |

## Choosing a value

The following table is a guide. If the business rules of the project say which value to use, follow them.

| Situation | Value |
| --- | --- |
| A typo was corrected. The meaning of the step does not change | `urt01` |
| A step was added. A torque value was changed | `urt02` |
| Only the nesting of elements or the attributes were corrected. The displayed text does not change | `urt03` |
| An applicable model was added. The content of the steps does not change | `urt04` |
| Only a reference target was corrected. The content of the steps does not change | `urt05` |

## Related rules

- A `reasonForUpdate` without `updateReasonType` is treated as a technical change (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.2).
- Changes made for the same reason point to the same `reasonForUpdate` (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.3).
- An issue whose `issueType` is not `changed` needs at least one `reasonForUpdate` if its `issueNumber` is greater than `001` (BREX-S1-00038 of the default BREX).
- [`updateHighlight`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/update-highlight/) states whether the reason appears in the highlights data module.

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Read | [`read_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/read-data-module/). `updateReasonType` is in `identAndStatus.reasonForUpdates[]` |
| Add only a reason for update | [`add_reason_for_update`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/add-reason-for-update/) |
| Add a reason when an in-work issue is started | `reason` of [`start_revision`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/start-revision/) |
| Add a reason together with change markup | `marking.reason` of [`edit_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/edit-data-module/) |
| Check whether a value is allowed | [`lookup_value`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/brex/lookup-value/) (`updateReasonType` in `target`, the value to check in `value`) |

No tool chooses the value of `updateReasonType`. Each tool takes the value the user has decided. The tools do not interpret the meaning of the value either.
